classification.description: Explicit foundation-owned name segments; source labels are not parsed.

locked.description: Built-in rules other data falls back to; they cannot be edited or deleted.

RoundingOutcome.description: A factor of 0 leaves the value unrounded.

termId.description: Registry size-term UUID, not a display label.

iconId.description: When set to anything but "none", it replaces the per-mode icons.

ColorStopOverride.description: A mode's patch for one stop: literal channels, or a palette link that takes precedence over them.

MethodInterpolation.description: A reusable blending method. Input and output endpoints belong to each consumer.

locked.description: Built-in interpolations other data falls back to; they cannot be edited or deleted.

ExpressionInterpolation.description: value → value formula. Variables: `x` and the parameter ids.

locked.description: Built-in interpolations other data falls back to; they cannot be edited or deleted.

FormulaParameter.description: A named numeric input shared by formulas and interpolations.

adaptable.description: Whether a foundation may bind this part to a mode parameter.

name.description:
Lightweight subset of the Spectrum token format: a `name` object with
app-specific keys, a `value`, and a stable `uuid`.

TokenName.description:
Lightweight subset of the Spectrum token format: a `name` object with
app-specific keys, a `value`, and a stable `uuid`.

polarityCompensation.description: 0–1 strength of the contrast polarity correction.

contrastMultiplier.description: Scales each contrast's distance from 1:1, applied after polarity compensation.

oppositeValue.description: Explicit value at the opposite background extreme; replaces the compensated value.

paletteColorId.description: Links the stop to a palette color; the palette value replaces the stop's own channels when resolved.

staticColors.description: The adaptive recipe and its mode edits remain dormant while these colors are active.
The adaptive recipe and its mode edits remain dormant while these colors are active.

componentSize.description: Retained until product defaults and their size/spacing presentation are defined (EPIC-2.5).

hasAdaptiveSettings.description: Distinguishes a never-enabled mapping from a configured mapping that is temporarily disabled.

pendingRules.description: Rules staged for the rule library on load.

base.description: Overrides the formula's base; ignored when the formula does not allow it.

parameters.description: Per-scale overrides of the formula's parameters; only parts the formula allows take effect.

ParameterBinding.description: Makes a scale parameter follow a mode parameter; values between points are interpolated, and outside the range they hold the end values.

points.description: At least two points, sorted by `at`.

at.description: Value of the bound mode parameter.

value.description: Value the scale parameter takes there.

Rules staged for the rule library on load.

opacity.description: Historical percentage input, decoded only to upgrade older saved data.

ScaleType.description: A named formula: index → value. Steps (the range of indices) belong to the foundation that uses it.

expression.description: Custom only. Variables: `i`, `base`, and the parameter ids.

locked.description: Reserved for items that cannot be edited or deleted.

textSizeAdaptation.description: Required for the canonical Type scale; never an optional adaptive switch.

ScaleTypeParameter.description: A formula part; the foundation may set its own value only when `overridable` is on.

overridable.description: Whether a foundation may set its own value for this part.

adaptable.description: Whether a foundation may bind this part to a mode parameter.

ScaleTypeBase.description: The value at index 0. The formula supplies a default; a foundation may override it when allowed.
